# MALDI-MSI data preparation 

## Software requirments 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(foreach)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(scater)
library(BiocParallel)
library(Cardinal)
```


## 1. Read in data 

```{r}
mse_1 <- readMSIData("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/raw/ztma_20_rcc_no_normalized_complete_spectrum.imzML", as = "MSImagingExperiment")
mse_2 <- readMSIData("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/raw/ztma_224_rcc_no_normalized_complete_spectrum.imzML", as = "MSImagingExperiment")

mse_1
mse_2
```

## 2. Preprocessing 

### Normalize 

```{r}
set.seed(22)
mse_1_norm <- process(normalize(mse_1, method="tic"), BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = 9))
mse_2_norm <- process(normalize(mse_2, method="tic"), BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = 9))
```


```{r}
saveRDS(mse_1_norm, "/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TM20norm.rds")
saveRDS(mse_2_norm, "/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TM224norm.rds")
```

CONTINUE HERE

```{r}
# Mean feature intensities
mean_1 <- summarizeFeatures(mse_1_norm, FUN="mean")
mean_2 <- summarizeFeatures(mse_2_norm, FUN="mean")


mean_df <- rbind(fData(mean_1) %>% as.data.frame %>% mutate(data = "TMA20"), fData(mean_2) %>% as.data.frame %>% mutate(data = "TMA224"))

ggplot(mean_df, aes(mz, mean, color = data))+
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5)+
  theme_classic()

ggplot(mean_df %>% filter(mz < 500 & mz > 400), aes(mz, mean, color = data))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()

ggplot(mean_df %>% filter(mz < 750 & mz > 740), aes(mz, mean, color = data))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()

ggplot(mean_df %>% filter(mz < 550 & mz > 540), aes(mz, mean, color = data))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()
```


```{r}
# check difference of mass bins 
mean_df_diff <- mean_df %>% group_by(data) %>% arrange(mz) %>% mutate(diff = c(NA,diff(mz)))

ggplot(mean_df_diff, aes(data, diff, color = data))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_classic()

ggplot(mean_df_diff, aes(mz, diff, color = data))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()
```

### Peak picking

```{r}
mse_1_peak <- process(peakPick(mse_1_norm, SNR = 3, method = "mad")) 
mse_2_peak <- process(peakPick(mse_2_norm, SNR = 3, method = "mad")) 
```


```{r}
# Mean feature intensities
mean_1 <- summarizeFeatures(mse_1_peak, FUN="mean")
mean_2 <- summarizeFeatures(mse_2_peakfData(mse_peaks), FUN="mean")


mean_df <- rbind(fData(mean_1) %>% as.data.frame %>% mutate(data = "TMA20"), fData(mean_2) %>% as.data.frame %>% mutate(data = "TMA224"))

ggplot(mean_df, aes(mz, mean, color = data))+
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5)+
  theme_classic()

ggplot(mean_df %>% filter(mz < 500 & mz > 400), aes(mz, mean, color = data))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()

ggplot(mean_df %>% filter(mz < 750 & mz > 740), aes(mz, mean, color = data))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()

ggplot(mean_df %>% filter(mz < 550 & mz > 540), aes(mz, mean, color = data))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()
```
